title: ClarifyPrompt eval fixture
description: One fixture = one input + expected behaviors. Every key under `expected` is optional; the runner only scores what's declared.

name.description: Stable identifier. Used in reports and to dedupe across runs.

description.description: One-line explanation of what this fixture verifies.

skip_unless_model_matches.description: Regex pattern; fixture is skipped unless LLM_MODEL matches. Useful for size-specific tests.

skip_if_model_matches.description: Regex pattern; fixture is skipped if LLM_MODEL matches. Useful for excluding tiny models from quality tests.

requires_workspace.description: Files to materialize in a temp workspace before running. Lets fixtures test workspace-signal-driven behavior.

setup.description: Optional list of MCP tool calls executed BEFORE the main `input`. Use this to load knowledge packs, register custom platforms, save outcomes, or anything else that establishes state the main call needs. Setup results are not scored.

input.description: Args passed to the MCP tool under test. Defaults to optimize_prompt; set `tool` to target another tool. `prompt` is required for optimize/clarify/ground/critique/compose; memory_search uses `query` instead.

tool.description: Which MCP tool to invoke. Default: optimize_prompt.

kinds.description: memory_search: which memory kinds to search.

force.description: clarify_with_user: always generate questions even when the analyzer is highly confident.

original_prompt.description: critique_prompt: when critiquing an optimized prompt, the original ask.

skip_rewrite.description: critique_prompt: skip the rewrite pass even when below threshold.

revise_threshold.description: critique_prompt: overall score below this triggers a rewrite.

post_critique.description: compose_prompt: run critique after the optimization.

auto_revise.description: compose_prompt: when critique returns a non-accept verdict + improvedPrompt, replace finalPrompt with the rewrite.

expected.description: Each property is one scoreable assertion. Omit any check that doesn't apply to this fixture.

platform.description: result.platform must equal this (e.g. derived default like 'midjourney' for image).

intent_confidence_min.description: intent_confidence must be at least this level.

shape_max_tokens_min.description: result.shape.maxTokens must be at least this.

shape_max_tokens_max.description: result.shape.maxTokens must be at most this.

must_contain.description: Case-insensitive substring matches against optimizedPrompt. ALL must be present.

must_not_contain.description: Case-insensitive substring matches that must NOT appear.

max_reading_grade.description: Flesch–Kincaid grade level of optimizedPrompt (compose: finalPrompt) must be ≤ this. Deterministic register-drift tripwire.

grounding_sources_must_include.description: Each value must appear (as exact match or prefix) in result.grounding.sources.

system_prompt_must_contain.description: Substrings in the rendered system prompt (read from the trace, not the response). Case-insensitive.

system_prompt_must_not_contain.description: Substrings that must NOT appear in the rendered system prompt (read from the trace). Case-insensitive.

no_error.description: When true, result.error must be absent.

min_questions.description: clarify_with_user: at least N questions returned.

max_questions.description: clarify_with_user: at most N questions returned.

question_dimensions_must_include.description: clarify_with_user: at least one returned question must carry each listed dimension tag.

questions_must_have_suggested_answer.description: clarify_with_user: when true, every question must carry a non-empty suggestedAnswer.

used_sources_min.description: ground_prompt: at least N sources must appear in result.usedSources.

dropped_sources_max.description: ground_prompt: at most N sources may appear in result.droppedSources.

overall_score_min.description: critique_prompt: overallScore must be at least this.

overall_score_max.description: critique_prompt: overallScore must be at most this.

dimensions_min.description: critique_prompt: at least N dimensions must be returned.

dimension_must_include.description: critique_prompt: every listed dimension name must appear in result.dimensions.

improved_prompt_present.description: critique_prompt: when true, result.improvedPrompt must be a non-empty string.

improved_prompt_absent.description: critique_prompt: when true, result.improvedPrompt must be absent.

stages_must_include.description: compose_prompt: every named stage must appear in result.stages.

stages_must_exclude.description: compose_prompt: none of the named stages may appear in result.stages.

revised.description: compose_prompt: whether finalPrompt was replaced by critique.improvedPrompt.

final_prompt_must_contain.description: compose_prompt: substrings that must appear in result.finalPrompt.

final_prompt_must_not_contain.description: compose_prompt: substrings that must NOT appear in result.finalPrompt.

count_min.description: memory_search: result.count must be at least this.

count_max.description: memory_search: result.count must be at most this.

top_result_must_contain.description: memory_search: result.results[0].content must contain all listed substrings.
